about.short: Creative director, photographer, director and CGI artist, based in Paris — and, more and more, a vibe coder.
bio: Trained in painting and furniture design, he co-founded the set design studio Le Creative Sweatshop before moving into photography, film and CGI.
He works for houses such as Hermès, Kenzo, Loewe, Dior, Acne Paper, Suntory and Amazon Japan — and on long personal series, from the masks of TAL to Aichmophobia.
He also vibe codes: building his own tools, generators and sites with AI, from Houdini setups to this website.
With Hyojeong Han, he runs iolo.paris, a shop of objects for which he also signs the art direction.
